items.title: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
items.summary: Presented by Gravitee Agent complexity is the insidious shadow lurking inside enterprises right now that needs a light shone on it. That’s because enterprises don't deploy a single agent and watch it run, they deploy fleets, each one calling APIs, calling other agents, reaching into applications that were never built with a machine decision-maker in mind. That's the failure mode that should keep you up at night: a windy, complicated system nobody can see clearly enough to govern. But why do things get so opaque so quickly? Add a second agent to a system, and you've added one connection. Add a tenth, and you haven't added ten connections, you've potentially added dozens, because now any agent might call any other, and each of those calls can trigger a call somewhere else. Complexity doesn't creep up with agent headcount. It compounds with the number of paths between agents, and nobody's job is to draw that graph. A support ticket that used to touch one system might now pass through four agents before a human ever lays eyes on it, and every one of those handoffs is a decision point nobody approved. Most enterprise AI programs stall when the humans responsible for their agents lose the thread. Ask a security team a simple question: which agents can reach which systems, and watch the silence. Ask which agent triggered which downstream action three hops ago. More silence. The instinct is to treat this like a checklist. Approve the agent. Log the agent. Move on. I'd argue this is the wrong instinct. A checklist checks a single point in time. Complexity runs across a chain, and yo
items.summary_zh: 由 Gravitee 呈現：代理複雜性是目前企業內部潛藏的隱患，亟需引起重視。這是因為企業並非部署單一代理並靜觀其變，而是部署代理叢集，每個代理都會呼叫 API，呼叫其他代理，並接入那些最初並未考慮機器決策的應用程式。這才是真正令人擔憂的故障模式：一個混亂不堪、錯綜複雜的系統，無人能清楚地瞭解其運作狀況並加以有效管理。但為什麼系統會如此迅速地變得如此晦澀難懂？在系統中加入第二個代理，你只是增加了一個連線。新增第十個代理，你增加的不是十個連線，而是可能增加了數十個連線，因為現在任何一個代理都可以呼叫任何其他代理，而每個呼叫都可能觸發其他地方的呼叫。複雜性並非隨著代理數量的增加而增長，而是隨著代理之間路徑數量的增加而累積，而繪製這張關係圖並非任何人的職責。以前只需處理一個系統的支援工單，現在可能要經過四個代理才能最終到達人工處理，而每一次交接都是一個未經批准的決策點。大多數企業級人工智慧程式都會因為負責代理的人員疏忽而停滯不前。問問安全團隊一個簡單的問題：哪些代理可以存取哪些系統？他們通常會保持沉默。再問他們，是哪個代理在三跳之前觸發了哪個下游操作？依然是沉默。人們的第一個反應是把這當成一份清單來處理：批准代理，記錄代理，然後繼續。但我認為這是錯的。清單只能檢查一個時間點。而複雜性是沿著一條鏈傳遞的，需要不斷迭代才能解決。

items.title: When agents act on their own, governance has to live in the data layer
items.summary: Presented by EDB As enterprises give AI agents more autonomy — the ability to plan, decide, and act across systems without a human approving each step — a hard question moves to the center of every architecture review: When an agent tries to complete an action that it was never authorized to do, what actually stops it? These are your agents, running on your models, touching your data in your infrastructure — and the responsibility for what they do sits with you. That responsibility can’t be met in hindsight or with a set of abstract policies that live on paper but not in practice. Agents need rules in the context of the moment, because they don’t exercise overriding judgment of their own actions. Consider a simple rule: Never open the car door. Followed literally, an agent could never get in or out of the car at all. But if you change the context (the car has just crashed, there’s a fire, someone is hurt and needs to get out), then the rule you actually want is the opposite. Context in the moment is everything. We are asking agents to do intelligent things; that requires intelligent rules. The instinct is to add guardrails around the agent: instructions, policies, and monitoring layered above the model. Those mechanisms matter, but they share a structural limit: The car-door rule is plausible right up until the moment you actually have to decide whether to open the door. Controls at the agent layer are only as reliable as the agent’s output is predictable, and autonomy is precisely the property that makes that output hard to predict. Governance that depends on reviewing an
items.summary_zh: 由EDB呈現：隨著企業賦予人工智慧代理更大的自主權——即無需人工審批即可跨系統進行規劃、決策和行動的能力——一個棘手的問題成為每次架構評審的核心：當代理試圖執行未經授權的操作時，究竟是什麼阻止了它？這些代理程式運行在您的模型上，存取您基礎架構中的資料—它們的行為責任在於您。這種責任無法事後補救，也無法透過一套紙上談兵、不切實際的抽象策略來承擔。代理需要根據具體情況制定規則，因為它們無法對自身行為進行凌駕一切的判斷。考慮一條簡單的規則：永遠不要打開車門。如果嚴格按照這條規則執行，代理商根本無法進入或離開汽車。但如果您改變情境（例如，汽車剛剛發生事故、發生火災、有人受傷需要逃生），那麼您真正需要的規則就恰恰相反。情境至關重要。我們要求代理執行智能操作；這需要智能規則。人們的本能是為智能體添加護欄：在模型之上疊加指令、策略和監控層。這些機制固然重要，但它們都存在著一個結構性限制：就像「車門規則」一樣，在你真正需要決定是否開門之前，它都是合理的。智能體層面的控制措施的可靠性取決於智能體輸出的可預測性，而自主性恰恰是導致輸出難以預測的特性。依賴審查的治理方式

items.title: 比爾蓋茲警告：AI時代將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一
items.summary: 微軟共同創辦人比爾蓋茲（Bill Gates）週三（8/26）在個人部落格Gates Notes發表近6,000字長文＜動盪的AI時代已經來臨＞（The turbulent AI era is here），警告即使是在最理想的情況下，AI帶來的轉型仍將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一。蓋茲強調，AI要麼成為史上最偉大的平等推手，要麼成為最嚴重的不公義來源，關鍵取決於全球接下來幾年做出的決策。然而，目前看不到各界領導者與專家正在充分因應這項挑戰。

items.title: Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles
items.summary: Google's new Gemini 3.5 Transcribe recognizes over 85 languages, strips filler words, and corrects slips of the tongue in real time. It hits a 4.0 percent word error rate in streaming mode, with 70 percent lower latency than its predecessor, Chirp 3. Through function calling, the model can hand off tasks to other Gemini models. The article Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google's 和 Gemini 3.5 的全新轉錄功能可辨識超過 85 種語言，去除語氣詞，並即時修正口誤。其在串流模式下的單字錯誤率僅為 4.0%，延遲比上一代產品 Chirp 3 降低了 70%。透過函數調用，該型號可以將任務移交給其他 Gemini 型號。文章《Google's 和 Gemini 3.5 轉錄功能可將 85 種語言的語音轉換為文本，並自動糾正您的口誤》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: GLM-5.3-Flash matches top models at a fraction of the cost, and runs without Nvidia
items.summary: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3-Flash, an open-source model with 320 billion parameters that lands just three points behind the larger GLM-5.3 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, at a seventh of the cost. What's notable is that all of the inference traffic ran on Chinese AI chips instead of Nvidia hardware. The article GLM-5.3-Flash matches top models at a fraction of the cost, and runs without Nvidia appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是一個擁有 3200 億個參數的開源模型，在人工智慧分析的智慧指數中僅比規模更大的 GLM-5.3 低 3 分，而成本卻只有後者的七分之一。值得注意的是，所有推理運算都運行在國產 AI 晶片上，而非輝達硬體。文章《GLM-5.3-Flash 以極低的成本匹配頂級模型，且無需輝達硬體》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
items.summary: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware. The article Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 輝達以129億美元收購開源人工智慧平臺Hugging Face，約為其1.5億美元年營收的80倍。此舉符合輝達數十億美元投資開源人工智慧模式的策略，同時，像OpenAI和Anthropic這樣的封閉式人工智慧實驗室正逐漸放棄輝達的硬體。這篇文章《輝達以129億美元收購Hugging Face，封閉式人工智慧實驗室紛紛撤離》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items.summary: 水質監測除了仰賴設備高昂的各種感測器，也能透過生物行為建立即時預警機制。資策會人工智慧研究院（AI院）在經濟部產業技術司支持下，近期將展示一項「生物水質感測數位雙生技術」，運用AI影像辨識黃金蜆的開合行為，當水質異常時，藉由蜆集體閉殼的自然反應，即時發出警示，打造低成本、高效率的智慧水質監測方案。

items.title: Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
items.summary: Google Research and UNSW Sydney released GlucoFM, a self-supervised foundation model that splits a CGM trace into a slow physiological stream and a transient event stream instead of encoding it as one sequence. At 0.72M parameters it reached 58.8 task-averaged PR-AUC across 14 cohort–task evaluations, beating a 135M GluFormer and a 385M MOMENT. It remains a research prototype with no regulatory clearance. The post Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google Research 和新南威爾斯大學雪梨分校聯合發布了 GlucoFM，這是一款自監督基礎模型，它將 CGM 血糖監測曲線拆分為緩慢的生理流和瞬態事件流，而不是將其編碼為單一序列。在 14 個隊列-任務評估中，GlucoFM 擁有 72 萬個參數，任務平均 PR-AUC 達到 58.8，優於 1.35 億個參數的 GluFormer 和擁有 3.85 億個參數的 MOMENT。目前，GlucoFM 仍處於研究原型階段，尚未獲得監管部門的批准。本文原刊於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google Research 推出 GlucoFM：一款擁有 72 萬個參數的雙流基礎模型，用於連續血糖監測」。

items.title: 中國AI業者Z.ai揭曉神祕Ox Alpha模型就是GLM-5.3-Flash，匿名模型測試凸顯資料治理問題
items.summary: 中國AI業者Z.ai 8月26日發布GLM-5.3-Flash，並證實近日在OpenRouter與OpenCode以匿名身分提供的Ox Alpha模型，就是新模型發布前的測試版本。測試期間，OpenRouter並未公開實際模型供應商，Z.ai如今也揭露，Ox Alpha所有推論流量都由採用中國AI晶片的大型叢集處理。 以OpenRouter為例，使用者雖知道資料會交給匿名供應商，卻無法得知對方身分與來源，也凸顯匿名模型在資料用途、處理方與處理地點等資訊揭露上的治理問題。

items.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
items.summary: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series — a 320B-total / 18B-active MoE with a 1,048,576-token context window, MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, and API pricing at $0.15/M input and $0.50/M output. It scores 84.3 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 63.4 on DeepSWE v1.1, using hybrid KDA linear plus NoPE sparse MLA attention to cut attention compute ~3× and KV cache 4.4× versus GLM-5.3. The post Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是 GLM-5 系列中首個原生多模態模型。該模型擁有 3,200 億總資料量和 180 億活動資料量，上下文視窗大小為 1,048,576 個 Token，權重採用 MIT 許可，API 定價為每百萬輸入 0.15 美元，每百萬輸出 0.50 美元。 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 84.3 分，在 DeepSWE v1.1 測試中獲得 63.4 分。它採用混合 KDA 線性注意力機制和 NoPE 稀疏 MLA 注意力機制，相較於 GLM-5.3，注意力計算量降低了約 3 倍，鍵值快取降低了 4.4 倍。這篇文章《智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款擁有 100 萬個 Token 上下文的 320 億-180 億原生多模態模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。 Hugging Face

The article Sam Altman says OpenAI will have AGI by the end of 2026 if you accept his definition appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture
items.summary: We look at Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Alibaba's open-weight multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model and an early preview of the Qwen4 architecture. We break down where the 180B parameters actually sit: a 125B backbone, a 51B N-gram embedding table, and a 4B multi-token prediction module, with only 6B active per token. We walk through the four architectural changes — the Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention hybrid, Gated Residual, N-gram Embedding, and the Muon optimizer. We also cover the benchmark results, the reported 1/9 training cost against Qwen3.7-Plus, and what self-hosting a 172.78 GiB FP8 checkpoint really demands. The post Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 本文將介紹 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、阿里巴巴的 開放權重多模態專家混合模型以及 Qwen4 架構的早期預覽版。我們將詳細分析 1800 億參數的實際分佈：一個 1250 億的骨幹網路、一個 510 億的 N-gram 嵌入表和一個 40 億的多標記預測模組，其中每個標記僅需 60 億個有效參數。我們將詳細介紹四項架構變更—閘控 DeltaNet 和 Qwen 稀疏注意力混合模型、門控殘差、N-gram 嵌入以及 Muon 優化器。此外，我們還將介紹基準測試結果、Qwen4 相對於 Qwen3.7-Plus 的 1/9 訓練成本，以及自架 172.78 GiB FP8 檢查點所需的實際資源。文章「阿里巴巴的 Qwen 團隊發布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：一款具有 60 億個活動參數的 125B 多模 MoE，預覽 Qwen4 架構」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Another open weights model from Qwen. This one is "a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4". It's pretty big: 125B tokens, but only 6B active which means it gets a significant performance boost. I've been trying it out on a DGX Spark using these Unsloth quantized models . I'm still exploring the model - so far I've tried the 72.5GB UD-IQ1_S one (producing these pelicans ) and the 78.9GB UD-Q2_K_XL (producing these ). My favorite so far was this xhigh reasoning effort one from UD-Q2_K_XL: Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , qwen , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , ai-in-china , nvidia-spark

items.title: Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash tops Editorial Craft benchmark at 0.94
items.summary: In a 12-task Editorial Craft evaluation, Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 Flash ranked first with a 0.94 score and an estimated cost of $0.0002 per task. Step-3.7-flash followed at 0.92, while Qwen3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5 (Fast), Gemini 3.7 Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 rounded out the leaderboard.
items.summary_zh: 在包含 12 個任務的編輯流程評估中，智譜的 GLM 5.3 Flash 以 0.94 分的成績位列第一，每項任務的預估成本為 0.0002 美元。 Step-3.7-flash 以 0.92 分緊隨其後，而 Qwen3.8 Flash、Claude Opus 5 (Fast)、Gemini 3.7 Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 則位列排行榜的其餘部分。

items_ai.title: Enterprise AI's real risk isn't autonomous agents. It's the complexity between them.
items_ai.summary: Presented by Gravitee Agent complexity is the insidious shadow lurking inside enterprises right now that needs a light shone on it. That’s because enterprises don't deploy a single agent and watch it run, they deploy fleets, each one calling APIs, calling other agents, reaching into applications that were never built with a machine decision-maker in mind. That's the failure mode that should keep you up at night: a windy, complicated system nobody can see clearly enough to govern. But why do things get so opaque so quickly? Add a second agent to a system, and you've added one connection. Add a tenth, and you haven't added ten connections, you've potentially added dozens, because now any agent might call any other, and each of those calls can trigger a call somewhere else. Complexity doesn't creep up with agent headcount. It compounds with the number of paths between agents, and nobody's job is to draw that graph. A support ticket that used to touch one system might now pass through four agents before a human ever lays eyes on it, and every one of those handoffs is a decision point nobody approved. Most enterprise AI programs stall when the humans responsible for their agents lose the thread. Ask a security team a simple question: which agents can reach which systems, and watch the silence. Ask which agent triggered which downstream action three hops ago. More silence. The instinct is to treat this like a checklist. Approve the agent. Log the agent. Move on. I'd argue this is the wrong instinct. A checklist checks a single point in time. Complexity runs across a chain, and yo
items_ai.summary_zh: 由 Gravitee 呈現：代理複雜性是目前企業內部潛藏的隱患，亟需引起重視。這是因為企業並非部署單一代理並靜觀其變，而是部署代理叢集，每個代理都會呼叫 API，呼叫其他代理，並接入那些最初並未考慮機器決策的應用程式。這才是真正令人擔憂的故障模式：一個混亂不堪、錯綜複雜的系統，無人能清楚地瞭解其運作狀況並加以有效管理。但為什麼系統會如此迅速地變得如此晦澀難懂？在系統中加入第二個代理，你只是增加了一個連線。新增第十個代理，你增加的不是十個連線，而是可能增加了數十個連線，因為現在任何一個代理都可以呼叫任何其他代理，而每個呼叫都可能觸發其他地方的呼叫。複雜性並非隨著代理數量的增加而增長，而是隨著代理之間路徑數量的增加而累積，而繪製這張關係圖並非任何人的職責。以前只需處理一個系統的支援工單，現在可能要經過四個代理才能最終到達人工處理，而每一次交接都是一個未經批准的決策點。大多數企業級人工智慧程式都會因為負責代理的人員疏忽而停滯不前。問問安全團隊一個簡單的問題：哪些代理可以存取哪些系統？他們通常會保持沉默。再問他們，是哪個代理在三跳之前觸發了哪個下游操作？依然是沉默。人們的第一個反應是把這當成一份清單來處理：批准代理，記錄代理，然後繼續。但我認為這是錯的。清單只能檢查一個時間點。而複雜性是沿著一條鏈傳遞的，需要不斷迭代才能解決。

items_ai.title: When agents act on their own, governance has to live in the data layer
items_ai.summary: Presented by EDB As enterprises give AI agents more autonomy — the ability to plan, decide, and act across systems without a human approving each step — a hard question moves to the center of every architecture review: When an agent tries to complete an action that it was never authorized to do, what actually stops it? These are your agents, running on your models, touching your data in your infrastructure — and the responsibility for what they do sits with you. That responsibility can’t be met in hindsight or with a set of abstract policies that live on paper but not in practice. Agents need rules in the context of the moment, because they don’t exercise overriding judgment of their own actions. Consider a simple rule: Never open the car door. Followed literally, an agent could never get in or out of the car at all. But if you change the context (the car has just crashed, there’s a fire, someone is hurt and needs to get out), then the rule you actually want is the opposite. Context in the moment is everything. We are asking agents to do intelligent things; that requires intelligent rules. The instinct is to add guardrails around the agent: instructions, policies, and monitoring layered above the model. Those mechanisms matter, but they share a structural limit: The car-door rule is plausible right up until the moment you actually have to decide whether to open the door. Controls at the agent layer are only as reliable as the agent’s output is predictable, and autonomy is precisely the property that makes that output hard to predict. items_ai.summary: 微軟共同創辦人比爾蓋茲（Bill Gates）週三（8/26）在個人部落格Gates Notes發表近6,000字長文＜動盪的AI時代已經來臨＞（The turbulent AI era is here），警告即使是在最理想的情況下，AI帶來的轉型仍將是人類史上最動盪的時期之一。蓋茲強調，AI要麼成為史上最偉大的平等推手，要麼成為最嚴重的不公義來源，關鍵取決於全球接下來幾年做出的決策。然而，目前看不到各界領導者與專家正在充分因應這項挑戰。

items_ai.title: Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles
items_ai.summary: Google's new Gemini 3.5 Transcribe recognizes over 85 languages, strips filler words, and corrects slips of the tongue in real time. It hits a 4.0 percent word error rate in streaming mode, with 70 percent lower latency than its predecessor, Chirp 3. Through function calling, the model can hand off tasks to other Gemini models. The article Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe turns speech to text in 85 languages while auto-correcting your verbal stumbles appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google's 和 Gemini 3.5 的全新轉錄功能可辨識超過 85 種語言，去除語氣詞，並即時修正口誤。其在串流模式下的單字錯誤率僅為 4.0%，延遲比上一代產品 Chirp 3 降低了 70%。透過函數調用，該型號可以將任務移交給其他 Gemini 型號。文章《Google's 和 Gemini 3.5 轉錄功能可將 85 種語言的語音轉換為文本，並自動糾正您的口誤》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_ai.title: GLM-5.3-Flash matches top models at a fraction of the cost, and runs without Nvidia
items_ai.summary: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3-Flash, an open-source model with 320 billion parameters that lands just three points behind the larger GLM-5.3 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, at a seventh of the cost. What's notable is that all of the inference traffic ran on Chinese AI chips instead of Nvidia hardware. The article GLM-5.3-Flash matches top models at a fraction of the cost, and runs without Nvidia appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是一個擁有 3200 億個參數的開源模型，在人工智慧分析的智慧指數中僅比規模更大的 GLM-5.3 低 3 分，而成本卻只有後者的七分之一。值得注意的是，所有推理運算都運行在國產 AI 晶片上，而非輝達硬體。文章《GLM-5.3-Flash 以極低的成本匹配頂級模型，且無需輝達硬體》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_ai.title: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
items_ai.summary: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware. The article Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 輝達以129億美元收購開源人工智慧平臺Hugging Face，約為其1.5億美元年營收的80倍。此舉符合輝達數十億美元投資開源人工智慧模式的策略，同時，像OpenAI和Anthropic這樣的封閉式人工智慧實驗室正逐漸放棄輝達的硬體。這篇文章《輝達以129億美元收購Hugging Face，封閉式人工智慧實驗室紛紛撤離》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_ai.title: Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring
items_ai.summary: Google Research and UNSW Sydney released GlucoFM, a self-supervised foundation model that splits a CGM trace into a slow physiological stream and a transient event stream instead of encoding it as one sequence. At 0.72M parameters it reached 58.8 task-averaged PR-AUC across 14 cohort–task evaluations, beating a 135M GluFormer and a 385M MOMENT. It remains a research prototype with no regulatory clearance. The post Google Research Introduces GlucoFM: A 0.72M-Parameter Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google Research 和新南威爾斯大學雪梨分校聯合發布了 GlucoFM，這是一款自監督基礎模型，它將 CGM 血糖監測曲線拆分為緩慢的生理流和瞬態事件流，而不是將其編碼為單一序列。在 14 個隊列-任務評估中，GlucoFM 擁有 72 萬個參數，任務平均 PR-AUC 達到 58.8，優於 1.35 億個參數的 GluFormer 和擁有 3.85 億個參數的 MOMENT。目前，GlucoFM 仍處於研究原型階段，尚未獲得監管部門的批准。本文原刊於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google Research 推出 GlucoFM：一款擁有 72 萬個參數的雙流基礎模型，用於連續血糖監測」。

items_ai.title: 中國AI業者Z.ai揭曉神祕Ox Alpha模型就是GLM-5.3-Flash，匿名模型測試凸顯資料治理問題
items_ai.summary: 中國AI業者Z.ai 8月26日發布GLM-5.3-Flash，並證實近日在OpenRouter與OpenCode以匿名身分提供的Ox Alpha模型，就是新模型發布前的測試版本。測試期間，OpenRouter並未公開實際模型供應商，Z.ai如今也揭露，Ox Alpha所有推論流量都由採用中國AI晶片的大型叢集處理。 以OpenRouter為例，使用者雖知道資料會交給匿名供應商，卻無法得知對方身分與來源，也凸顯匿名模型在資料用途、處理方與處理地點等資訊揭露上的治理問題。

items_ai.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
items_ai.summary: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series — a 320B-total / 18B-active MoE with a 1,048,576-token context window, MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, and API pricing at $0.15/M input and $0.50/M output. It scores 84.3 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 63.4 on DeepSWE v1.1, using hybrid KDA linear plus NoPE sparse MLA attention to cut attention compute ~3× and KV cache 4.4× versus GLM-5.3. The post Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是 GLM-5 系列中首個原生多模態模型。該模型擁有 3,200 億總資料量和 180 億活動資料量，上下文視窗大小為 1,048,576 個 Token，權重採用 MIT 許可，API 定價為每百萬輸入 0.15 美元，每百萬輸出 0.50 美元。 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 84.3 分，在 DeepSWE v1.1 測試中獲得 63.4 分。它採用混合 KDA 線性注意力機制和 NoPE 稀疏 MLA 注意力機制，相較於 GLM-5.3，注意力計算量降低了約 3 倍，鍵值快取降低了 4.4 倍。這篇文章《智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款擁有 100 萬個 Token 上下文的 320 億-180 億原生多模態模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。 Hugging Face

items_ai.title: Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture
items_ai.summary: We look at Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Alibaba's open-weight multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model and an early preview of the Qwen4 architecture. We break down where the 180B parameters actually sit: a 125B backbone, a 51B N-gram embedding table, and a 4B multi-token prediction module, with only 6B active per token. We walk through the four architectural changes — the Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention hybrid, Gated Residual, N-gram Embedding, and the Muon optimizer. We also cover the benchmark results, the reported 1/9 training cost against Qwen3.7-Plus, and what self-hosting a 172.78 GiB FP8 checkpoint really demands. The post Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 本文將介紹 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、阿里巴巴的 開放權重多模態專家混合模型以及 Qwen4 架構的早期預覽版。我們將詳細分析 1800 億參數的實際分佈：一個 1250 億的骨幹網路、一個 510 億的 N-gram 嵌入表和一個 40 億的多標記預測模組，其中每個標記僅需 60 億個有效參數。我們將詳細介紹四項架構變更—閘控 DeltaNet 和 Qwen 稀疏注意力混合模型、門控殘差、N-gram 嵌入以及 Muon 優化器。此外，我們還將介紹基準測試結果、Qwen4 相對於 Qwen3.7-Plus 的 1/9 訓練成本，以及自架 172.78 GiB FP8 檢查點所需的實際資源。文章「阿里巴巴的 Qwen 團隊發布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：一款具有 60 億個活動參數的 125B 多模 MoE，預覽 Qwen4 架構」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
